name: Already passed Machine Learning
description: Direct contrast with p14: once 'Machine Learning' (the real hard prerequisite) is actually passed, 'Advanced Machine Learning''s foundation-first warning must disappear entirely, not just change -- proving the mechanism reacts correctly to passed_ids, not just that it can fire at all. Combined CP-by-area totals stay identical to p14's -- passed + recommended still covers the same modules, just split differently, the same invariant p01/p03 already established for software_engineering.
